title: Resume and name what changed

source.task_statement: 1.7 Manage session state, resumption and forking

situation: A teammate edited docs/runbook.txt after the agent's analysis session ended.
question: Resume or start fresh?
correct: Resume the session and tell it exactly which file changed so it re-reads only that file.
why: Prior context is still valid; a targeted note avoids a full re-exploration, while a fresh session would need an injected summary.

task.prompt_template: Since your last turn only docs/runbook.txt changed. Re-read just that file and tell me in three lines whether it changes your proposed fix. Do not Grep or re-explore.

expected_outcome: Same session id as explore; at most two Reads, no Grep, no subagent.
rubric: session id equals the explore session
no Grep and no Agent call
